nom: Vichy Purete Thermale Fresh Cleansing Gel

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the gel can leave skin feeling tight and overly dry after showering, though one describes it as gentle and suitable for dry winter skin.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer with sensitive skin reports burning around the eyes and face starting on the third day of use, with the sensation lasting a while; another notes a slight scent that could bother scent-sensitive users.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports the cleanser rinses clean and does not leave their skin dry.

concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports their skin cleared after a single use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports burning and dryness suggesting barrier irritation, describing skin as overly dry and tight after use; this is not echoed by other reviewers, who report gentleness.

aspects.libelle: Burning sensation on face and eyes
Strips skin and removes makeup poorly
Large bottle lasts long, good value

extraits.texte: I bought this cleanser because I have other Vichy products that I love and I figured I would give the cleanser a try. The first couple times I used it I liked it, but by the third day of using it it started to burn around my eyes and face. The burning sensation does not go away for a while, and after I get out of the shower my skin feels overly dry and tight. Perhaps this is better suited for oily skin but I was disappointed as it was marketed for sensitive skin.

I bought this thinking it was the same formula it is not. It dries out my skin plus strips away everything in a harsh way. Doesnt take off my basuc foundation well. Dont waste your money there are better face washes than this
The cleansing gel is too watery and feel that my skin is not as clean as the previous version/formula. Will discontinue using it.

extraits.titre: Light, Foaming, but with a slight scent
extraits.texte: I've been enjoying using this new face wash. I love the gel texture and it foams up nicely. It does have a slight scent to it. While it doesn't bother me, someone who is sensitive to scents might want to try a sample first.

I was in search of a good face cleanser and originally bought this cleanser on sale to try out. I was pleasantly surprised at how much I loved it. You need very little to get a good lather going. It rinses clean and doesn't leave my combination skin dry. I've tried other cleansers since finishing the bottle, but I am realizing how much more I love this one and miss using it.
Love this game changing cleanser. Struggling with rosacea prior to buying this cleanser. Skin cleared after one use.
I like how gentle this cleanser is, especially in the winter when my skin is very dry. I do think it gets my make up off just fine and the big bottle lasts me at least six months so I save money too.

reserve: Only 7 reviews are available, so the read is thin and individual accounts (especially the single rosacea and sensitivity reports) should not be generalized.
